title: Search, list, upsell and price
caption: flights.search → flights.listResults → flights.getOffer → flights.upsell → flights.price (ota/docs/flows/search-and-price.md, src/shopping). Selling prices come from the pricing engine; customer scope never sees net amounts.

steps.label: POST /v1/flight-searches {mode: simple, origin, destination, dates, travellers}
single flight t:<tenantId>:<env>:search:<sha256> (30 s); rl:amadeus:cred / rl:amadeus:ten buckets; amadeus:token:<credId>:<env>
Flight Offers Search (max = search_defaults.maxResults, default 150, 30 s timeout)
supplier_requests row; markup_rules + fee_rules → flight_searches (completed) + flight_offers (net, markup, selling)
201 FlightSearch (srch_…, resultCount, facets)
steps.note: No offers: 201 with zero. Timeout: 504 SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT, search failed. No connection: 424 SUPPLIER_NOT_CONFIGURED.

steps.label: SQL filter/sort within the search (no Amadeus call); 410 SEARCH_EXPIRED after expires_at
Branded Fares Upsell (identical request reuses the stored upsell: cached: true)
priced_offers (price_changed, selling_total = net + markup + fees, expires_at = min(now + offer_ttl_minutes, lastTicketingDate))
201 PricedOffer (prc_…); priceChanged with old and new totals
